name: Hello script
summary: The smallest possible NextOS Script: one command that writes a friendly, timestamped note to your Notes folder.

seo.title: Hello script - a NextOS Script example
seo.description: A one-file NextOS Script: bind a command to Mod+Shift+H and it writes a timestamped hello note to ~/Notes. The reference example for writing your own.

faq.a: Nothing more than its name says: running its command (bound to Mod+Shift+H, or from the Scripts app) writes ~/Notes/hello.md with the current time and a note about what triggered it, then shows a notification. It exists to be read, not to be useful on its own.

faq.q: What permission does it ask for?
faq.a: One: fs:write:~/Notes, so it can write the note. It asks for nothing else - no network, no other tools, no other folders.
